$comment: Conductor loop cli-native sandbox profile. Passed to headless `claude -p` via `--settings` when loop-state.json has "sandbox": "cli-native". Enables Anthropic's built-in bubblewrap+socat sandbox (no Docker; host needs `bubblewrap` + `socat`). failIfUnavailable makes it fail-closed: if the sandbox can't start, the beat exits non-zero rather than running unsandboxed. Add YOUR git host + package registries to network.allowedDomains before a real run.
